evidence.title: Transfer Learning in Nonparametric Regression with Deep ReLU Networks

summary: Researchers demonstrate that applying transfer learning to nonparametric regression models built with deep ReLU networks significantly improves prediction accuracy and data efficiency. The method leverages pre‑trained deep architectures to adapt to new regression tasks with limited labeled data, offering a promising direction for statistical learning and AI applications.
title: Transfer Learning Enhances Nonparametric Regression via Deep ReLU Networks
